title: TaskFlow Pro
description: A beautiful project management app with kanban boards, real-time collaboration, and AI-powered task suggestions.
longDescription:
TaskFlow Pro is a comprehensive project management solution built for modern teams. It features drag-and-drop kanban boards, real-time collaboration using WebSockets, and an AI assistant that helps break down complex tasks into manageable subtasks.

The app supports multiple workspaces, custom labels, due date tracking, and integrates with popular tools like Slack and GitHub. Built with performance in mind, it handles thousands of tasks without breaking a sweat.

title: FitTrack Mobile
description: A fitness tracking app built with React Native and Expo, featuring workout logging, progress charts, and social challenges.
longDescription:
FitTrack Mobile is a cross-platform fitness companion built with React Native and Expo. It helps users track their workouts, monitor progress with beautiful charts, and compete with friends through social fitness challenges.

The app features a custom workout builder, integration with Apple Health and Google Fit, push notifications for workout reminders, and offline support for gym sessions without WiFi. The UI is designed to be motivating and easy to use mid-workout.

title: DevFolio Next
description: A developer portfolio template built with Next.js, featuring MDX blog support, view transitions, and perfect Lighthouse scores.
longDescription:
DevFolio Next is an open-source portfolio template designed specifically for developers. Built with Next.js and server-side rendering, it achieves perfect Lighthouse scores while looking stunning.

Features include an MDX-powered blog with syntax highlighting, automatic OG image generation, RSS feed, sitemap, and beautiful view transitions between pages. The design is fully customizable through CSS variables.

title: ChatBuddy AI
description: An AI chatbot platform with multiple personality modes, conversation memory, and beautiful streaming UI built with React.
longDescription:
ChatBuddy AI is an intelligent chatbot platform that goes beyond simple Q&A. Users can switch between different AI personality modes — from professional assistant to creative writing partner to coding buddy.

The app features streaming responses with a beautiful typing animation, conversation history with search, export conversations to markdown, and a prompt library for common tasks. Built with a focus on UX, every interaction feels smooth and responsive.

title: SnapGram Native
description: A social media app clone built with React Native featuring stories, reels, real-time chat, and image filters.
longDescription:
SnapGram Native is a feature-rich social media application built from scratch with React Native and Expo. It replicates core Instagram functionality while adding unique features.

The app includes a stories feature with tap-to-progress, a reels player with gesture controls, real-time direct messaging, image filters using native processing, and a discover feed with infinite scroll. Built with smooth 60fps animations throughout.

title: E-Commerce Dashboard
description: A comprehensive admin dashboard for e-commerce platforms with analytics, inventory management, and order tracking.
longDescription:
E-Commerce Dashboard is a full-featured admin panel designed for online store owners. It provides real-time analytics, inventory management, order processing, and customer insights all in one place.

Key features include interactive charts and graphs, bulk product import/export, automated low-stock alerts, customer segmentation, and revenue forecasting. The dashboard is fully responsive and works seamlessly on tablets for warehouse use.

title: Recipe Realm
description: A recipe discovery app with ingredient-based search, meal planning, and nutritional information powered by AI.
longDescription:
Recipe Realm helps food lovers discover new recipes based on ingredients they already have. Simply scan your fridge or type in what you've got, and the AI suggests delicious meals you can make.

Features include weekly meal planning with grocery list generation, nutritional breakdown for each recipe, step-by-step cooking mode with timers, and community recipe sharing. The app also supports dietary preferences and allergen filtering.

title: Expense Tracker
description: A minimalist expense tracking app built with React Native featuring budget goals, spending insights, and beautiful charts.
longDescription:
Expense Tracker is a beautifully designed personal finance app that makes tracking spending effortless. With one-tap expense logging and smart categorization, users can understand their spending habits at a glance.

The app features monthly budget goals with progress tracking, spending category breakdown with animated charts, recurring expense reminders, and export to CSV/PDF. It works completely offline with local-first data sync.
